Chuck Norris Jokes

  1. If you have five dollars and Chuck Norris has five dollars, Chuck Norris has more money than you.
  2. Chuck Norris can kill two stones with one bird.
  3. Chuck Norris can speak Chinese. In Russian.
  4. When Chuck Norris cuts onions, onions cry.
  5. Chuck Norris built the house he was born in.
  6. Chuck Norris uses pepper spray to season his meat.
  7. Chuck Norris can’t turn left because he’s always right.
  8. Chuck Norris can close a revolving door.
  9. How many push-ups can Chuck Norris do? All of them.
  10. Chuck Norris can build a snowman out of rain.

Blonde Jokes

Two blondes fell down a hole. One said, "It's dark in here isn't it?" The other replied, "I don't know; I can't see."

Q: Why can't a blonde dial 911?
A: She can't find the eleven.
